description: Unit test class for the OpenmrsUtil utility class, testing various utility functions such as parsing parameter lists, joining collections, numeric range checks, system properties, and list comparisons.

classes.name: OpenmrsUtilUnitTest
classes.description: Test class for {@link OpenmrsUtil} providing unit tests for utility functions.
